HAVE YOU CHECKED OUT OUR WEBSITE YET?

The Laredo Roleplay website is here, and there are some cool features to check out! We're working on making it a useful place for our community, with more ways to personalise your experience and keep everything in one place.

🌐 WEBSITE: https://laredo-roleplay.pages.dev/

🎒・INVENTORY SYSTEM

Our website includes an inventory feature, giving users a dedicated place to view and manage their inventory.

It's another part of the website we're building to make the experience more interactive and give members more to explore beyond the usual server information.

🎨・UNLOCKABLE THEMES

Want to customise how the website looks? 👀

The website also features unlockable themes, letting you explore different looks and personalise your experience as you unlock them.

It's a nice way to give the website your own style instead of having everyone use the exact same appearance.

🔥・WHAT ELSE CAN YOU CHECK OUT?

🚔 Department information — Learn about our departments and the opportunities available.

📋 Website information — Find useful details about Laredo Roleplay.

🎨 Customisation — Explore the themes and personalisation features available.

🎒 Inventory — Check out the website's inventory feature.

🛠️・MORE UPDATES TO COME

We're continuing to develop Laredo Roleplay and improve the website. Make sure to check it out and keep an eye on announcements for future updates!

If you've got suggestions or ideas for features you'd like to see, let us know in the Discord.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌐 WEBSITE: https://laredo-roleplay.pages.dev/

We have some exciting updates for the community!

## 🧭 New Staff Chain of Command
Our new chain of command makes it clearer who to contact and how staff concerns are handled:

**Owner → Leadership → Executive Team → Internal Affairs → Management → Supervisory → Administrators → Moderators**

For routine questions or concerns, contact the next rank above you. If your concern involves that person, take it to the next level.

> **Community Manager, Server Developer, and Discord Developer** are specialist roles outside the chain unless they also hold a staff rank.

## 🌟 New Leadership
Please welcome our new **Leadership team**! They’ll help guide staff and support the community as we continue to grow.

## 🚒 Laredo Fire Department Liveries
New **Laredo Fire Department liveries** are now available!

## 🌐 Applications, Chain of Command & Website
You can find the **applications**, **chain of command**, and **website** in #📘┃information・🎃.

> Moderator applications are open! You can access the application in #📘┃apply・🎃. Please check the requirements before applying.

Thank you for being part of **Laredo Roleplay**. We look forward to seeing you in the community!

💚 World Mental Health Day — October 10

Remember, you are never alone. It's okay to ask for help, and your mental health matters. Be kind to others and check in on your friends. 💚

📞 Helplines

🇳🇴 Norway:

* Mental Helse: 116 123

* Children and Young People: 116 111

* Emergency: 113

* Online support: [https://findahelpline.com/](https://findahelpline.com/)

🌍 Worldwide: [https://findahelpline.com/](https://findahelpline.com/)

You matter. You are not alone. 💚

Hey everyone,
We’ve just pushed a major update to the server and our bot. Here’s everything you need to know:
🤖 Bot Update
New & improved commands
Faster response times
Better logging and moderation tools
Fixed several bugs reported by staff
Online 24/7

🔄 Discord Overhaul
The entire server has been reorganized for better structure and easier navigation.

Channels, categories, and voice channels have been cleaned up and themed around Laredo.
🎭 New Roles
We’ve added new roles to better organize the community and staff:

Updated department roles
New staff ranking roles
Special access roles for scenes & sessions

🔐 Permissions Update
Permissions have been completely reworked:

Clearer access for each department
Better separation between staff, members, and visitors
Improved security on staff & development channels
Scene and RF channels now have proper access control

Please re-check your roles and make sure everything looks correct.

If you’re missing a role or can’t access something you should be able to, open a ticket.
Thanks for your patience while we made these changes.

Enjoy the new layout and updated bot!
— Management Team
